scope: Live Highlight overlay session start, stop, mode, sender admission, and same-URL reload/cross-tab races
policy: One represented overlay is pinned to its initiating tab and document. Switching active tabs retains that representation and shows a Stop there control. Starting on another page explicitly retires the prior session. There is no automatic follow behavior in the source to preserve.
source_contradiction: The old store represented one overlayTabId, but the old start path could leave another tab's overlay mounted. The old bridge claimed to mirror the live overlay even though it accepted any sender. The correction gives the representation one tabId, documentId, pageKey, URL, and unique sessionId and admits only that sender/session.
changes: Publish a pending session before saved-highlight lookup and invalidate it on tab loading/removal; after each await require the same active page identity and session before publishing active state.
Target injection and control messages to the Chrome documentId; bind the content overlay with HIGHLIGHT_START and carry its sessionId through capture, clear, state, paint, stop, and mode.

Reject old-document, other-tab, and old-session messages at the side-panel bridge. Recheck capture admission after asynchronous organization and bearer resolution, immediately before database insertion.
Keep saved highlight URL/domain history and Data/Scrape handoffs unchanged.
